_comment: Placeholder assembly-point data bundled with the app. Section 5.3's REST API has no endpoint for evacuation routes or assembly points, even though Section 6.4 requires caching them offline — flagged in docs/nexus-log.md. Bundling as a static asset satisfies 'useful with no connection' for the prototype/demo; a real deployment needs an authority-managed data source and a backend endpoint to serve it. ap-4/ap-5/ap-6 were added because the original three (all in central Taiping) sat 3.3-6.4km from the actual river nodes -- too far for a fast-onset flood evacuation. Each of these three is a real, OSM-verified school or place of worship within ~0.4-1.5km of one node, chosen as smaller, nearer fallbacks; the original three stay as larger-capacity, further-out options. map_screen._nearestAssemblyPoint() always picks whichever point (of all six) is closest to the person's actual position, so this list doesn't need to be node-specific in code -- it just needs enough close options to choose from.
